headline: LAD @ MIL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is LAD 4.44 at MIL 3.57, with a projected total of 8.01. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward LAD: LAD moved +0.82 runs while MIL moved +0.44, changing the projected margin by +0.38 runs. The projected total climbed +1.26, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -15.2%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Brandon Sproat has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Shohei Ohtani, Teoscar Hernández, Jake Bauers, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Blake Perkins, Max Muncy because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
